IBM is a global technology and consulting company helping clients address business challenges through hybrid cloud, artificial intelligence, and technology transformation. The Associate Application Developer will design, develop, and support customized, scalable applications and interfaces while collaborating with clients and cross-functional teams on generative AI and other technology projects.

Responsibilities
Working across the entire system architecture to design, develop, and support high quality, scalable products and interfaces for our clients
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and define technical specifications for generative AI projects
Employing IBM's Design Thinking to create products that provide a great user experience along with high performance, security, quality, and stability
Working with a variety of relational databases (SQL, Postgres, DB2, MongoDB), operating systems (Linux, Windows, iOS, Android), and modern UI frameworks (Backbone.js, AngularJS, React, Ember.js, Bootstrap, and JQuery)
Creating everything from mockups and UI components to algorithms and data structures as you deliver a viable product

Ability to translate business requirements into technical solution
Exposure to web application development concepts and frameworks, including front-end and/or back-end development
Familiarity with generative AI modeling, ethics, and methodologies
Familiarity with Microservices architecture, infrastructure concepts and cloud platforms AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, and Google Cloud
Familiarity with relational databases
Foundational programming exposure in JavaScript – writing and reading Javascript including but not limited to: functions, loops, arrays, objects (JSON), error handling, asynchronous concepts, string and number handling
Foundational programming exposure in at least one of: .NET/ASP.NET, C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript
Exposure to technical understanding of modern software development patterns
Experience using tools like Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI assistants to research, write, analyze, and improve productivity, while applying critical thinking and validation
Experience working within an Agile team structure (sprints, backlogs, standups, story points) and comfort adapting to iterative development and shifting priorities
Willingness to travel up to 100%
Preferred
Bachelor's Degree
Preferred Majors: MIS, CS, Business Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Economics, User experience design, Web development)
Have flexibility to work across architecture - building both front-end and backend
Exposure to reading, navigating, and manipulating JSON objects
Experience working with relational databases
Familiarity with core ITIL concepts and workflows (incident, problem, change, request management)
Exposure to cloud and AI concepts such as Azure services, data platforms, security, and AI models through coursework, labs, internships, or personal projects, with a willingness to keep learning
Benefits
Healthcare benefits including medical & prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, and mental health & well being
Financial programs such as 401(k), cash balance pension plan, the IBM Employee Stock Purchase Plan, financial counseling, life insurance, short & long- term disability coverage, and opportunities for performance based salary incentive programs
Generous paid time off including 12 holidays, minimum 56 hours sick time, 120 hours vacation, 12 weeks parental bonding leave in accordance with IBM Policy, and other Paid Care Leave programs
Paid family leave benefits to eligible employees where required by applicable law
Training and educational resources on our personalized, AI-driven learning platform where IBMers can grow skills and obtain industry-recognized certifications to achieve their career goals
Diverse and inclusive employee resource groups, giving & volunteer opportunities, and discounts on retail products, services & experiences
